Trainer Onboarding & Profile Approval Fl: A Learner selecting a teaching account type on "Teach on HanGo" becomes a Trainer and is routed straight into the profile wizard, not the Trainer Dashboard.
column3: 1. Log in as a LEARNER and open the "Become a Trainer" entry point (e.g. homepage "Trở thành giáo viên" section or profile menu). 2. On the "Teach on HanGo" screen, select either the "Teacher" (Professional) or "Tutor" (Peer Tutor) card. 3. Tap "Proceed with profile".
column4: The TRAINER role and a TrainerProfile (status=PENDING_VERIFICATION, trainerType as selected) are created immediately; the app navigates directly to the "Complete Teaching Profile" onboarding details screen, not to the Trainer Dashboard - the Dashboard/Draft-course screens stay unreachable until onboarding fully completes (see SYS_FLOW_TRN_TC02).
column5: LEARNER account logged in with no existing TrainerProfile.

Trainer Onboarding & Profile Approval Fl: The login-time onboarding gate always re-routes a Trainer account to the step matching its current status/agreement/payout state, never straight to the Trainer Dashboard until every step is done.
column3: 1. Log in as a Trainer whose profile is PENDING_VERIFICATION with no trainerType set yet - confirm landing on "Teach on HanGo" type-selection. 2. Repeat for PENDING_VERIFICATION with a trainerType already chosen - confirm landing on "Complete Teaching Profile". 3. Repeat for AWAITING_APPROVAL, SUSPENDED, and PENDING_VERIFICATION-with-adminNotes - confirm each lands on the read-only Application Status screen. 4. Repeat for VERIFIED with agreementSigned=false - confirm landing on the E-Cooperation Agreement screen. 5. Repeat for VERIFIED+agreementSigned=true with an empty bank account - confirm landing on Payout & Identity Info. 6. Repeat for VERIFIED+agreementSigned=true+bank account set - confirm landing on the real Trainer Dashboard.
column4: Every login re-evaluates the profile and routes to exactly the step described in each sub-case; the Trainer Dashboard (TrainerShellPage) is reached only in sub-case 6.
column5: Trainer test accounts pre-seeded at each of the six states above (or one account walked through them sequentially).

column5: Account already has a TrainerProfile.

Trainer Onboarding & Profile Approval Fl: Editing any onboarding field auto-saves as a draft after a short debounce - there is no explicit "Save Draft" button in the current UI.
column3: 1. On "Complete Teaching Profile", type into the Bio field or Contact Phone Number field. 2. Watch the header area immediately after typing, then again about 1 second after stopping. 3. Reload the page and reopen the profile.
column4: The header shows "Saving draft..." while the 1-second debounce timer runs, then "Draft auto-saved"; the typed values persist after reload; profile status remains PENDING_VERIFICATION and does not yet appear in the Admin review queue.
column5: Trainer role granted, profile status=PENDING_VERIFICATION, viewing the onboarding details screen.

Trainer Onboarding & Profile Approval Fl: Submitting is blocked client-side when Bio is under 50 characters or the phone number fails the VN mobile format/blacklist check.
column3: 1. Enter a Bio under 50 characters, fill everything else validly, tap "Submit Profile" - observe the error. 2. Fix the Bio, then enter an invalid phone (wrong prefix, e.g. 02912345678) or a blacklisted dummy number (e.g. 0000000000 or 1234567890), tap "Submit Profile" again.
column4: Case 1: inline error and toast requiring Bio >=50 characters; submission never reaches the server. Case 2: inline error and toast about the required 03/05/07/08/09-prefixed 10-digit number, rejecting both malformed and blacklisted dummy numbers; status stays PENDING_VERIFICATION in both cases.
column5: Trainer role granted, on the onboarding details screen.

Trainer Onboarding & Profile Approval Fl: Submitting is blocked when gender, avatar, or at least one certificate is missing (three sequential client-side checks, all before the API is ever called).
column3: 1. With Bio and phone valid, leave Gender unselected and tap "Submit Profile" - expect a gender error. 2. Select Gender but leave the avatar unset, submit again - expect an avatar error. 3. Upload an avatar but leave the certificates list empty, submit again - expect a credentials error.
column4: Each sub-case shows its own toast ("Please select your gender." / "Please upload an avatar image." / "Please upload at least one credentials proof.") and blocks submission; status never leaves PENDING_VERIFICATION.
column5: Bio and phone already valid; the one field under test is left empty in each sub-case.

Trainer Onboarding & Profile Approval Fl: A Trainer who completes every required field and uploads at least one certificate through the Cloudinary-backed "Add Degree & Certificate" uploader submits successfully for Admin review.
column3: 1. Fill Bio (>=50 chars), a valid phone, Gender, and upload an avatar. 2. Tap "Add Degree & Certificate", name the certificate, upload its image, and confirm. 3. Tap "Submit Profile".
column4: The certificate image uploads to Cloudinary and appears under "Uploaded Documents"; submission succeeds, status moves PENDING_VERIFICATION -> AWAITING_APPROVAL, and the trainer is routed to the Application Status screen; the profile now appears in the Admin "Trainer Onboarding Approvals" queue.
column5: All other mandatory fields valid; at least one certificate ready to upload.

column4: The login gate routes straight to the Application Status screen showing "Application Under Review"; the only available action is "View My Application" (read-only); status is unchanged.
column5: Profile status=AWAITING_APPROVAL.

column4: The list refreshes for each filter/search combination to show only matching profiles, including the AWAITING_APPROVAL one from SYS_FLOW_TRN_TC07.

column5: An AWAITING_APPROVAL profile exists.

column5: An AWAITING_APPROVAL profile exists.

column4: Nothing blocks the non-zero price at Draft, Submit, or Publish - the course publishes at the price the Trainer entered; BR-G02 is unenforced in the current build (createTrainerCourse/updateTrainerCourse/submitTrainerCourse/publishTrainerCourse in TrainerDashboardController carry no zero-prior-course check).
column5: Trainer is VERIFIED and fully onboarded with zero prior published courses (builds on SYS_FLOW_CRS's course authoring flow for the Submit/Publish steps).

Trainer Onboarding & Profile Approval Fl: Full journey: Learner becomes Trainer, completes profile, gets approved, signs the agreement, configures payout, and reaches the Dashboard to publish their first course.
column3: 1. Register/log in as a Learner and become a Trainer (TC01). 2. Complete and submit the profile (TC04-TC07). 3. Log in as Admin and approve it with a valid revenue share (TC11). 4. Log back in as the Trainer - sign the agreement (TC17-TC18) and complete payout setup (TC19-TC20). 5. From the now-reachable Trainer Dashboard, author a course through Draft, Submit, and have a Course Manager Publish it (SYS_FLOW_CRS flow).
column4: Every stage transitions as documented (PENDING_VERIFICATION -> AWAITING_APPROVAL -> VERIFIED, agreementSigned=true, bank details set) and the Trainer ends the journey on the real Trainer Dashboard with one Published course visible in the public catalog.
column5: Fresh Learner account; Admin and Course Manager accounts available.
